title: Naming conventions
text: myceliumr enforce specific sample ID formats, adopt consistent project-wide convention. Encoding assay role ID can aid readability: Tumor: {assay}_T{subject} (e.g., “wes_T101”, “wgs_T001”) Normal: {assay}_N{subject} (e.g., “wes_N101”, “wgs_N001”) Single-cell/RNA: {assay}_{subject}_{rep} (e.g., “scrna_101_1”, “bulk_rna_101_2”) Tumor/normal pairs stored sample_map; derive demand sample_pairs(), yields pair_id {tumor_sample_id}__{normal_sample_id} (e.g., “wes_T101__wes_N101”).

title: Naming conventions
text: Study objects: snake_case, descriptive (e.g., my_study, nf1_study) explicitly named study examples. Cohort objects: snake_case (e.g., cohort, nf1_cohort, study_cohort). Subject objects: Rarely used directly; accessed via cohort@subjects[[subject_id]]. AnalysisSpec objects: Use spec name primary identifier (stored registry name key). Data tables: snake_case _tbl suffix use descriptive names like subject_data, wes_samples.

title: S7 AnalysisSpec class — AnalysisSpec
code: AnalysisSpec(   name = character(0),   assay = character(0),   level = character(0),   format = character(0),   description = NA_character_,   path_template = NA_character_,   root_key = NA_character_,   reader = character(0),   key_cols = character(0),   feature_type = NA_character_,   gene_col = NA_character_,   id_type = NA_character_ )

title: S7 AnalysisSpec class — AnalysisSpec
text: name Character scalar unique analysis name (key registry). assay Character scalar assay type (e.g., "wes_somatic", "wes_germline", "snrna"). Required. level Character scalar granularity analysis produces results. Must one : "subject": one result per subject. "pair": one result per tumor/normal (case/control) pair, derived sample_pairs() cohort's sample_map. "cohort": single result whole cohort. Required. format Character scalar file format (e.g., "rds", "tsv", "txt"). Required. description Character scalar human-readable description analysis. Optional, defaults NA. path_template Character scalar templated path analysis output. Supports substitution tokens: {root} (root_key), {subject_id}, pair tokens {tumor_sample_id}, {normal_sample_id}, {pair_id} (latter three supplied sample_pairs() level = "pair"). Optional, defaults NA. root_key Character scalar key cohort@paths list use {root} template value (e.g., "msi_root", "sig_root", "wes_root"). Optional, defaults NA. reader Character scalar function name read files matching spec (e.g., "read_msi_txt", "read.csv"). Must valid function name. Required. key_cols Character vector column names use keys loading analysis table. Determines rows indexed (e.g., c("subject_id") c("pair_id")). Required. feature_type Optional character scalar declaring analysis's features translate across species orthologize(): "interval" (liftover) "gene" (ortholog mapping). Optional, defaults NA. gene_col Optional character scalar naming gene-identifier column feature_type = "gene". Optional, defaults NA. id_type Optional gene identifier type feature_type = "gene": "symbol", "entrez", "ensembl". Optional, defaults NA.
